name: Rocket
summary: Classic space rocket with a porthole and fins; the launch animation shows the flame and the rocket rising.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the engine bell stands on y (the launch pad)

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 300 px wide and 1220 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.5 for a smaller rocket

params.name: anim
params.note: launch = flame burns and the rocket accelerates upward; bob = small wobble

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (no visible change for a symmetric rocket)

author: krakujs
